responses.reason: Right that exact two-way matches are rare, but the idea does not need them.
responses.named_flaw: Assumes every exchange must be a simultaneous, same-person swap.
responses.revised_claim: Some students with a live need would give time back later, not necessarily to the same person.

responses.reason: Helper overload is a real risk, but the proving test measures it directly by asking helpers whether they would help again.

statement: Then don't insist on a perfect swap. Match by hand through one club and let help be paid forward. If helpers burn out, the trial will show it, because we ask them after every session.
